title: Thai Crispy Fish with Herbs
description: A simple Thai dish featuring crispy fish topped with fresh herbs. Crispy fish adds a delightful texture to this dish, and the herbs bring a burst of freshness.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs (such as parsley, basil, and cilantro)

instructions: 2. Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and a pinch of salt.
4. Dip each fish fillet in the flour mixture, coating both sides.
5. Dip the floured fish in the beaten egg, making sure it's fully coated.
6. Roll the egg-coated fish in the crispy breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs onto the fish to ensure they stick.
7. Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
8. Fry the breaded fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
9. Transfer the fried fish to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
10. Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
11. While the fish is baking, mix together the chopped fresh herbs and a squeeze of lime juice.
12. Serve the crispy fish topped with the herb mixture and additional crispy breadcrumbs if desired.
